rationale: The ES 8.8 Premier aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The current task lists ES 8.7+ on Cloud, enabled assistant and paired SOAR, and documents existing AI-triaged findings, the first-ten burst, approximately 200 findings per tenant per day, frontier models and connector/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task retains its historical AI SOC Analyst name and Cloud scope. The ES 8.8 release notes mark November 4 product GA. Editions and regional tables distinguish the combined Premier workflow from base assistant and deployment exceptions. For CMP, the current task names Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The setup guide is indexed-only following direct HTTP 404 and names SAIA 2.4+. The 2.3.6 installation guidance still describes Cloud Connected as planned for 2.4.0 and the 2.1.1 workaround lacks Agent Mode. The usable CMP workflow remains unconfirmed.

deployments: CSP supporting scope; no entitlement, exact pairing, agent rollout or authorization
exclusions: Exact pairings, entitlement, rollout and customer authorization remain separate.
